digest.component_or_area: plan-review signing finalization (CLI and library boundaries)
propositions: A passing LLM plan review consumes full cost but can leave the ticket without a signed plan-review attestation unless signing was separately requested.
Every mutating public plan-review entry point (CLI review-plan and library review_plan) must sign and persist a plan-review attestation by default on a non-degraded PASS.
Deliberate unsigned execution requires an explicit opt-out: --no-sign on the CLI and sign=False in the library.
BLOCK, INDETERMINATE, degraded, and local/unattested-source results must remain unsigned as non-certifiable verdicts.
A default invocation with a current claim-valid attestation must reuse it without rerunning the LLM or emitting a duplicate signature.
A PASS whose signature persistence fails returns the retryable nonzero disposition and points to the sign-review recovery path.
